external_dependency.name: Current assistant session
external_dependency.request: C4 immutable cut + schema -> explicitly transported session input
external_dependency.return: session proposal bytes -> C1 generated provenance -> C4 admission -> C0 scheduling
external_dependency.usage: unknown unless declared, full native reservation when unknown
external_dependency.capacity: export/response byte envelopes; no exact token-count assertion

component_review.C4: Existing reasoning/proposal authority; added explicit sole-model exchange, native reference admission unchanged
component_review.C0: Distinct waiting-reasoner state and resumable native proposal import; manual byte-budget path separated from exact-token serving path
component_review.C1: Immutable raw generated output and lineage retained; no external response becomes independent world evidence
component_review.C2_C5_C6: Existing capabilities preserved; not newly qualified by transport changes

gates.architecture: pass scoped implementer self-review; existing owner/port contracts unchanged
gates.contract: pass Cedar exact public-access/schema/identity and explicit handoff guards
gates.runtime: pass disposable Cedar mission/export, native image/large-text byte envelope and six DB integrity checks
gates.integration: pass operational launch readiness at recorded source/config; actual benchmark unstarted
gates.scientific: not run; no Cedar result, comparative advantage or blind generalization claimed

review_limit: Self-review only. Existing baseline REVISE statuses are not promoted. Bundled skill reference/checker files unavailable through supplied skill resource; explicit 56-lane inventory consistency checked here, not claimed as that checker result.

deployment_scope.source: examples/autonomous/cedar_session.py and cedar_readiness.py; no C0-C7 production source change
requirements: IMP-R26 attributed model assistance and evidence lineage
deployment_scope.C0_C4: Sole standard-stage exact native export/import; manual UI handoff; 262144-byte request,65536-byte response; unknown tokens fully reserved
deployment_scope.C1_C4: Original selected records, byte hashes, source identities and generated proposal lineage retained; synthetic probe stays in disposable stores
deployment_scope.C4_C3: Existing candidate submission/admission policy unchanged; no automatic acceptance
deployment_scope.C0_C7_broker: Same public Cedar manual, loopback broker, exact mission digest and frozen corpus; new grant only at actual start; one mission-only disposable probe
deployment_scope.outside_dependency: Current session identity/usage unauthenticated; not an unattended API; shared case/implementation context prevents blind/comparative claims
deployment_scope.time_and_recovery: Fresh64-turn/six-hour/256-request bounds. Same-kernel process reopen preserves pending job and makes zero extra calls. No kernel or expired-authority automatic restart.
deployment_scope.failure_and_saturation: Native bounded correction and capacity/access termination retained. Wrapper rejects JSON strings/stale jobs before writing. No automatic unknown-completion retry.
deployment_scope.evaluator: Explicitly fenced before native termination; never included in pending reasoner inputs
deployment_scope.launch: No top-level benchmark start/evaluation/import call in any saved preparation cell; start_actual_cedar() is defined, uncalled
